The '''Village Plaza''' is a location in the [[Rift Dimension]]. It is based on the {{zone|Village}}.

{{RiftGuide|Reverse-Murder Investigation|Fancy Sneakers|Barry, Premier Leader of SkyBlock|Cowboy Nick's Rabbits|Craft the Crux Relic|Shen Auctions|Enigma: Rabbit in the Hat!|more=9|souls=7}}

== Purpose ==
{{Sectionstub}}
The '''Village Plaza''' features many attractions. The player must have secured both the {{Item|mrahcemiT esrevrorriM}} and {{Item|Chicken N Egg Timecharm}} and have a minimum of {{stat|rt|8:00}} remaining in order to access the location.

=== Montezuma Cat Soul ===
{{Main|Montezuma Pet}}
Located in [[Book in a Book]], a sub-location of the '''Village Plaza''', the player can find the fifth [[Montezuma Pet|Montezuma Soul Piece]], which is located at {{Coords|2|63|-17}}. Finding the soul piece will add an additional {{stat|rt|+15}} to the [[Montezuma Pet|Pet]].
